items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: The priest come, say, All right. The priest bless you, Paddy.

ctx.x: We'll stop it. We can stop it.

I thought I said... Somebody now... When we come on home then... We break up then... We done broke up then we come on home then... Then we won't have no more... Then we won't have no more fuel... Or else somebody else... Die, you understand? When somebody else die well... Well we got our... Well... I know where you stay. Alright... I'll... I'll... I'll... I'll ring up to you. Now you might be working. Alright... You're working. She gets a... She gets a telephone number. She gets a... She gets a news. I said...…
Say, did the guys in the second lines ever ask the bands for tunes?
